import unittest
from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch
from some_module import SymptomsManager, Symptom, ConsultationRequest

class TestSymptomsManager(unittest.TestCase):

    def setUp(self):
        self.symptoms_manager = SymptomsManager()

    @patch('some_module.Symptom')
    def test_add_new_symptom(self, MockSymptom):
        # Arrange
        symptom_name = "Fever"
        symptom_description = "High body temperature"
        MockSymptom.return_value = Symptom(symptom_name, symptom_description)

        # Act
        self.symptoms_manager.add_symptom(symptom_name, symptom_description)

        # Assert
        MockSymptom.assert_called_once_with(symptom_name, symptom_description)
        self.assertIn(MockSymptom.return_value, self.symptoms_manager.symptoms)

    def test_view_and_update_symptom(self):
        # Arrange
        symptom_name = "Fever"
        symptom_description = "High body temperature"
        updated_description = "Elevated body temperature"
        symptom = Symptom(symptom_name, symptom_description)
        self.symptoms_manager.symptoms.append(symptom)

        # Act
        self.symptoms_manager.update_symptom(symptom_name, updated_description)

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(symptom.description, updated_description)

    def test_view_and_update_non_existent_symptom(self):
        # Arrange
        symptom_name = "Fever"
        updated_description = "Elevated body temperature"

        # Act & Assert
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, f"Symptom '{symptom_name}' not found"):
            self.symptoms_manager.update_symptom(symptom_name, updated_description)

    def test_delete_symptom_no_consultation_request(self):
        # Arrange
        symptom_name = "Fever"
        symptom_description = "High body temperature"
        symptom = Symptom(symptom_name, symptom_description)
        self.symptoms_manager.symptoms.append(symptom)

        # Act
        self.symptoms_manager.delete_symptom(symptom_name)

        # Assert
        self.assertNotIn(symptom, self.symptoms_manager.symptoms)

    def test_delete_symptom_with_consultation_request(self):
        # Arrange
        symptom_name = "Fever"
        symptom_description = "High body temperature"
        symptom = Symptom(symptom_name, symptom_description)
        consultation_request = ConsultationRequest(symptom)
        self.symptoms_manager.symptoms.append(symptom)
        self.symptoms_manager.consultation_requests.append(consultation_request)

        # Act & Assert
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, f"Symptom '{symptom_name}' cannot be deleted as it is used in consultation requests"):
            self.symptoms_manager.delete_symptom(symptom_name)

    def test_add_symptom_with_empty_name(self):
        # Arrange
        symptom_name = ""
        symptom_description = "High body temperature"

        # Act & Assert
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "Symptom name cannot be empty"):
            self.symptoms_manager.add_symptom(symptom_name, symptom_description)

    def test_add_symptom_with_empty_description(self):
        # Arrange
        symptom_name = "Fever"
        symptom_description = ""

        # Act & Assert
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "Symptom description cannot be empty"):
            self.symptoms_manager.add_symptom(symptom_name, symptom_description)

    def test_view_symptom_list(self):
        # Arrange
        symptom_name = "Fever"
        symptom_description = "High body temperature"
        symptom = Symptom(symptom_name, symptom_description)
        self.symptoms_manager.symptoms.append(symptom)

        # Act
        symptom_list = self.symptoms_manager.get_symptom_list()

        # Assert
        self.assertIn(symptom, symptom_list)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
